purpose: Fixed-slot supplemental operation checks for EIP-8182 issue 10

proving.pool: upstream Circom Groth16 pool circuit; unchanged
proving.authorization: upstream Groth16 demo secret circuit; this does not prove wallet-signature authorization
proving.key_trust: Development keys; demo auth key was generated in local single-contributor setup

environment.anvil: 1.7.1, Cancun, chainId 1, genesis timestamp 1735689000, block gas limit 30000000, code size limit disabled
environment.genesis: upstream assets/eip-8182/shielded-pool-state.json installed via Anvil RPC
environment.transaction_sender: local Anvil account; registered authorizer is impersonated fixture address
environment.inputs: The original seven fixed-slot cases use two real deposits, amounts 10 and 5, owned by one fixture owner. Exact S-02/S-03 cases use one real deposit of 10 and one phantom input; S-04 uses two real deposits of 2 and 3.
environment.outputs: The circuit always has three slots. Dummy slots still produce commitments but carry zero value and the mandated dummy owner hash.
environment.output_note_data: Three fixed plaintext upstream fixture byte strings, eip-8182-output-0/1/2; no encryption, recipient recovery, delivery or sync is tested here
environment.secrets: Deterministic public test secrets and Anvil accounts in witness/raw files; never use these keys or setup for funds
environment.gas_scope: eth_getTransactionReceipt.gasUsed; deployment, policy registration, minting, deposits and transact are separate rows
environment.proof_time_scope: snarkjs WASM groth16.prove only, excluding witness generation and local verification
environment.chain_reset: anvil_reset before every case, with genesis block captured
environment.run: anvil --port 18556 --chain-id 1 --hardfork cancun --timestamp 1735689000 --gas-limit 30000000 --disable-code-size-limit; bash benchmarks/prior-eips/cases/run.sh /tmp/eip-8182-cases-issue10 http://127.0.0.1:18556 all; bash benchmarks/prior-eips/cases/run-encrypted.sh /tmp/eip-8182-cases-issue10 http://127.0.0.1:18556 all
environment.reference_setup: bash benchmarks/prior-eips/setup.sh /tmp/eip-8182-cases-issue10 (use an isolated reference checkout)

case_meanings.eth_withdraw_partial: 10+5 ETH inputs -> 8 public ETH + 5 sender change note + 2 fee note; output slot 1 dummy
case_meanings.eth_withdraw_full: 10+5 ETH inputs -> 15 public ETH; all three output slots dummy, fee zero
case_meanings.erc20_withdraw_partial: 10+5 MockERC20 inputs -> 8 public tokens + 5 sender change note + 2 fee note; output slot 1 dummy
case_meanings.erc20_withdraw_full: 10+5 MockERC20 inputs -> 15 public tokens; all three output slots dummy, fee zero
case_meanings.transfer_partial: 10+5 MockERC20 inputs -> 8 recipient note + 5 sender change note + 2 fee note; all output slots real
case_meanings.transfer_full: 10+5 MockERC20 inputs -> 15 recipient note; output slots 1 and 2 dummy, fee zero
case_meanings.merge: 10+5 MockERC20 inputs -> 15 owner-controlled note; output slots 1 and 2 dummy, fee zero
case_meanings.s02_transfer_full_10: 10 real MockERC20 input plus phantom -> 10 recipient note; change and fee dummy, fee zero
case_meanings.s03_transfer_partial_3: 10 real MockERC20 input plus phantom -> 3 recipient note + 7 sender change note; fee dummy, fee zero
case_meanings.s04_transfer_2_plus_3: 2+3 real MockERC20 inputs -> 4 recipient note + 1 sender change note; fee dummy, fee zero
case_meanings.s05_self_split_10: 10 real MockERC20 input plus phantom -> 3 and 7 owner-controlled notes; fee dummy, fee zero; newly emitted note commitments must differ from the consumed note
case_meanings.s05_self_recreate_10: 10 real MockERC20 input plus phantom -> new 10 owner-controlled note; change and fee dummy, fee zero; new note commitment must differ from the consumed note
case_meanings.s06_eth_withdraw_full_10: 10 real ETH input plus phantom -> 10 public ETH; all output slots dummy, fee zero
case_meanings.s06_eth_withdraw_partial_3: 10 real ETH input plus phantom -> 3 public ETH + 7 sender change note; slots 1 and 2 dummy, fee zero
case_meanings.s02_eth_transfer_full_10: 10 real ETH input plus phantom -> 10 recipient ETH note; change and fee dummy, fee zero
case_meanings.s03_eth_transfer_partial_3: 10 real ETH input plus phantom -> 3 recipient ETH note + 7 sender change ETH note; fee dummy, fee zero
case_meanings.s04_eth_transfer_2_plus_3: 2+3 real ETH inputs -> 4 recipient ETH note + 1 sender change ETH note; fee dummy, fee zero

encrypted_trial.path: encrypted/<case>/ with independent reset, fresh proof, receipt, delivery and sync records
encrypted_trial.output_data: Each real transact output is encrypted with upstream Sepolia demo ML-KEM-768 plus X25519 recipient keys; each dummy slot publishes empty bytes with keccak256(empty) modulo field bound in the proof
encrypted_trial.recovery: The upstream indexer fetches ShieldedPoolTransact logs and decrypts every real transact output with deterministic test keys
encrypted_trial.deposit_delivery: Depositor retains the self-generated note secret, so deposits publish empty outputNoteData in these trials; later spend of the deposited note is verified. Recovery of a deposit by a distinct recipient is not measured.
encrypted_trial.full_withdrawal: Full ETH/token withdrawal has zero real note outputs, so no output encryption is needed; all three dummy slots publish empty bytes.
encrypted_trial.gas_and_time: Receipt gas includes encrypted output bytes where present; delivery encryption, pool/auth proving, RPC log fetching, trial decryption and index processing are measured separately. Each case is a single trial, not a median.

scenario_mapping_limit: The original transfer_full, transfer_partial and merge cases use two real inputs of 10+5 and are supplementary operation-path checks. Dedicated s02/s03/s04 cases for both MockERC20 and ETH, plus s05/s06 cases, match the specification's logical amounts and real-input counts. S-05 merge is covered by the two-input merge case, while split and recreation have dedicated one-input cases. Encrypted trials test log-based recovery for each real transact output, but do not test a subsequent spend by that recipient. ETH deposit receipts are followed by real consumption in ETH withdrawal cases, supporting the deposit-to-spend portion of S-01.
